title: I JH 9134 NDE 9134
content: In 2007, when I was 9 years old, my older sister accidentally hit me between the eyes. At that moment, I fainted. I felt an incredibly warm sensation. I was in a comfortable sitting position, in a place I can not describe in words. Although short, I watched something like a movie of all the experiences I had gone through in my life. I saw the people and faces of people I knew. I happily watched the moving images while receiving an indescribable feeling of warmth and love. For 30 to 40 minutes I looked back in my life. Then, as if the lights turned off, I came out of the space I was in. When I opened my eyes, my sister and my mother had worried looks on their faces as they were trying to shake me to wake me up. When I regained consciousness, I felt extreme happiness as if I had gone on a journey to a place no one knew about. Although it happened 14 years ago, the memories of the experience are still really vivid. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 2007 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Although I thought I fainted for a long time, it was not longer than 5 minutes. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. Nothing particularly different. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was at the highest level of consciousness throughout the whole experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I experienced a visual sensation like motion blurring. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don’t remember anything in regards to hearing. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain. I’m uncertain but I felt the space I was in was wrapped with unknowable light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I remember sitting or lying down comfortably in an extremely vast unknown space and surrounded by what seemed like light. What emotions did you feel during the experience? It was an indescribable feeling of warmth and love. I felt wrapped by a goddess of love. I have not felt this feeling while alive on earth. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control. I just saw happy and sad experiences that were memorable in my life. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? No comment What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I believe that there might be an afterlife. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Unknown Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? No. Nothing has changed. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I hardly remember anything else besides the mystical experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes. At the age of 15 and 18, I saw a ghost-like form. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes. I spoke about it for the first time before taking this survey. They were surprised. It was this friend whom I told about the experience that introduced me to this website. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. That it was a mystical and warm experience. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain

environment.environment_other_detail: An "extremely vast unknown space"; sitting or lying down comfortably; "wrapped with unknowable light."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return occurred "as if the lights turned off" and he "came out of the space" and opened his eyes.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Older sister accidentally hit him between the eyes; he fainted.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel; he found himself in a vast light-wrapped space, experienced a life-review-like "movie," then returned as if "the lights turned off."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Visual sensation "like motion blurring" during the experience; described feeling "wrapped by a goddess of love" but also stated no beings/presences were encountered.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I happily watched the moving images while receiving an indescribable feeling of warmth and love."; "I felt wrapped by a goddess of love."; "Then, as if the lights turned off, I came out of the space I was in."
